title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password option in the right-click menu
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap dates, menu behaviour and existing password policy controls are supported. Two minor clarifications remain: describe the saving policy's documented reach rather than calling it unconfirmed, and mention the authentication policy's default once-per-session prompt frequency.

claims.claim: The saving policy is at Group Policy Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Password manager and protection > Enable saving passwords to the password manager.
claims.quote:
GP name: Enable saving passwords to the password manager
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Password manager and protection

claims.claim: The saving policy's registry location is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value PasswordManagerEnabled.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: PasswordManagerEnabled
Value type: REG_DWORD

claims.claim: PasswordManagerEnabled controls saving new passwords to Edge's password manager.
claims.quote: If you enable or don't configure this policy, users can save and add their passwords in Microsoft Edge.

claims.claim: Disabling PasswordManagerEnabled does not prevent use of previously saved passwords.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, users can't save and add new passwords, but they can still use previously saved passwords.

claims.claim: PasswordManagerEnabled is a user/profile-scoped policy.
claims.quote: Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: PasswordManagerEnabled is not documented as governing this option.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, users can't save and add new passwords, but they can still use previously saved passwords.
claims.fix: Remove 'Not documented as governing this option.' from controls[0].note and the matching table note. Keep the documented qualification that disabling this policy still permits use of previously saved passwords, as stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/passwordmanagerenabled.

claims.claim: The blocklist policy is at Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Password manager and protection > Configure the list of domains for which the password manager UI (Save and Fill) will be disabled.
claims.quote:
GP name: Configure the list of domains for which the password manager UI (Save and Fill) will be disabled
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Password manager and protection

claims.claim: The blocklist registry location is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\PasswordManagerBlocklist, with numbered values 1, 2, 3.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\PasswordManagerBlocklist
Value name: 1, 2, 3, ...
Value type: List of REG_SZ

claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist disables Save and Fill for listed domains.
claims.quote: Configure the list of domains where Microsoft Edge should disable the password manager. This means that Save and Fill workflows are disabled, ensuring that passwords for those websites can't be saved or auto filled into web forms.

claims.claim: Users cannot use the password manager for URLs configured in PasswordManagerBlocklist.
claims.quote: In addition, users can't use password manager for those URLs.

claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist is supported on Windows and macOS, not Android or iOS.
claims.quote:
Windows: ≥ 99
macOS: ≥ 99
Android: Not supported
iOS: Not supported

claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist is a per-profile policy, matching the user scope.
claims.quote: Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: The authentication policy is at Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Password manager and protection > Configures a setting that asks users to enter their device password while using password autofill.
claims.quote:
GP name: Configures a setting that asks users to enter their device password while using password autofill
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Password manager and protection

claims.claim: The authentication policy's registry location is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value PrimaryPasswordSetting.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: PrimaryPasswordSetting
Value type: REG_DWORD

claims.where: controls[2].governs, note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: WithDevicePassword requires device authentication before saved-password autofill.
claims.quote: If you set this policy to 'WithDevicePassword', users have to enter their device password (or preferred mode of authentication under Windows) to prove their identity before their password is autofilled.
claims.fix: Add to controls[2].note and its matching table note: 'The prompt frequency defaults to Ask permission once per browsing session; users can change it to Always ask permission.' This qualification is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/primarypasswordsetting.
